captions.linkedin:
For 32 years, the VIX has averaged 4.2 points above realized S&P 500 volatility. That gap is the volatility risk premium. Cboe published the entire methodology to harvest it.

Most retail options traders are buying the gap. The PUT index is selling it, mechanically, every month.

Here's the complete logic from the Cboe PUT methodology and Bondarenko 2019. No black box:

🔹 CASH-SECURED. 100% collateral in T-bills, no leverage, bounded max loss.
🔹 MONTHLY ROLL. Write 1-month ATM SPX puts at the 3rd-Friday expiration cycle.
🔹 VRP HARVEST. Capture the gap between implied and realized over the holding period.
🔹 ATM STRIKE. Select the listed strike nearest to current index level.
🔹 INTEREST ACCRUAL. Collateral earns the T-bill rate, a material part of total return.
🔹 TAIL RISK SALE. Accept crash losses in exchange for steady premium income.

Cboe PUT index / Bondarenko 2019. Severe drawdowns in 2008, 2018, and 2020. Negative skew. Sharpe ratio understates tail risk. You verify it.
